notes: The equipment class required at each stage of a hydrometallurgical leach circuit, built from real vendor-published mining/hydrometallurgy literature -- not a generic process-engineering description. Every manufacturer named here has real, documented mining-duty literature on file, not just a category-level product match.

rows.chemistry: Copper: dilute sulfuric acid solution dripped onto the ore heap (Cu2O3 + H2SO4 -> Cu2(SO4)3 + H2O). Gold/Silver: cyanide solution.
rows.equipment_class: Driplines, sprinklers, distribution/mainline piping, pressure regulators, control valves
liberty_manufacturers: Netafim -- Leach Line X/A/U driplines (5-yr warranty), GyroNet Turbo sprinklers, FlexNet HP flexible mainline, 75/90/100 Series valves with a dedicated MIN (mining) configuration
Asahi/America -- Type-57P butterfly, Type-21 ball, Type-15 diaphragm valves, QM Remote Cycle actuation, Chem Proline PE single-wall piping

rows.chemistry: Pregnant leach solution (PLS) draining from the heap base, collected for downstream processing.
rows.equipment_class: Collection piping, butterfly valves, disc filters, strainers
liberty_manufacturers: Asahi/America -- Type-75 butterfly valves, PDCPD (polydicyclopentadiene) butterfly valves
Netafim -- Manual disc filters rated pH 2-13, ScreenGuard metal screen strainers

rows.chemistry: Organic extractant strips copper selectively from the pregnant leach solution, upgrading and purifying it before electrowinning.
rows.equipment_class: Metering pumps, transfer piping, valves for the organic/aqueous circuit
liberty_manufacturers: ProMinent -- dedicated Solvent Extraction application page; Delta (solenoid-driven, adapts to fluctuating back pressure) and Sigma (motor-driven, 17-1030 l/h) metering pumps
Asahi/America -- Type-21 ball, Type-14 diaphragm, and globe valves named specifically for SX-EW
Richter Chemie-Technik -- lined sealless mag-drive pumps; own Industries page names "Leaching reactions, Electrolysis processes"

rows.chemistry: Electrolytic deposition of pure copper cathode from the loaded electrolyte.
rows.equipment_class: Circulation pumps, tankhouse piping and valves
liberty_manufacturers: ProMinent -- "Electrolytic Metal Extraction" named as one of its five real hydrometallurgical processes
Richter Chemie-Technik -- "Electrolysis processes" and "Acid and lye recycling/pre-concentrating" named industries

rows.chemistry: Two-stage pH/ORP-controlled process: cyanide -> cyanate -> carbonate, with an explicit cyanogen chloride gas hazard if pH isn't raised fast enough (target under 0.1 ppm).
rows.equipment_class: pH/ORP instrumentation, dosing pumps, reaction tanks
liberty_manufacturers: GF Signet -- cyanide destruction process knowledge (2-stage pH/ORP setpoints), electrode selection for cyanide-poisoning-resistant service
ProMinent -- metering pumps for reagent dosing

rows.chemistry: Polymer flocculant dosing to settle ore-concentrate sludges; high-solids underflow pumping.
rows.equipment_class: Slurry pumps, polymer metering systems, knife gate isolation valves
liberty_manufacturers: Schurco Slurry USA -- 7 series to 30,000 gpm; Mine Dewatering, Tailings, and Filter Press Feed named applications
AVCO Valve -- 6100 Series knife gate for slurry isolation
ProMinent -- polymer metering systems (ULTROMAT ULPa/ULDa, PolyRex, DULCODOS ULFb)

rows.chemistry: Evaporation of excess tailings/raffinate water to manage the circuit's water balance.
liberty_manufacturers: Netafim -- GyroNet Turbo sprinklers with a MegaStand Floating Base variant purpose-built for evaporation pond deployment
